title: Google Wins Conditional Nod From Seoul to Offer Precision Maps
title_zh: 谷歌赢得首尔有条件许可提供精确地图
summary: Google Maps has long offered limited functionality in South Korea because of restrictions on exporting detailed geographic data, a policy rooted in security concerns.
summary_zh: 长期以来，谷歌地图在韩国提供的功能有限，原因是出于安全考虑而限制导出详细地理数据。

title: Why Franklin Templeton is betting big on tokenised funds
title_zh: 富兰克林邓普顿为何大举押注代币化基金
summary: Traditional finance is shifting its focus in crypto beyond bitcoin, according to Roger Bayston of Franklin Templeton.
summary_zh: 富兰克林邓普顿 (Franklin Templeton) 的罗杰·贝斯顿 (Roger Bayston) 表示，传统金融正在将重点转向比特币之外的加密货币。

title: 9 luxury homes under the £2m mansion tax threshold
summary: The mansion tax comes into effect in April 2028 and will be based on values in 2026. Here are sumptuous homes under the £2m threshold that will be exempt.
summary_zh: 豪宅税将于 2028 年 4 月生效，并将以 2026 年的价值为基础。以下是门槛低于 200 万英镑的豪华住宅将获得豁免。

title: Citrini Scare Marked the Bottom, Says Fund Betting on Bounce
title_zh: 基金押注反弹，Citrini恐慌标志着底部
summary: The fund sold some of its top-performing stocks, including European luxury goods companies, to invest in beaten-down software stocks.
summary_zh: 该基金出售了一些表现最好的股票，包括欧洲奢侈品公司，以投资遭受重创的软件股票。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip after Nvidia-led slump dampens AI mood again
title_zh: 今日股市：英伟达引领的股市暴跌再次打压人工智能情绪，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货均下跌
summary: The prospects for AI to sustain build-out spending and to harm legacy industries continue to be front of mind for Wall Street.
summary_zh: 人工智能维持扩建支出和损害传统产业的前景仍然是华尔街关注的首要问题。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq retreat as Nvidia falls 5% despite stellar earnings
title_zh: 今日股市：标普 500 指数和纳斯达克指数下跌，英伟达尽管盈利出色，但仍下跌 5%
summary: Investors are assessing Nvidia's earnings report for a steer on the AI trade.
summary_zh: 投资者正在评估英伟达的盈利报告，以了解其对人工智能行业的指导作用。

title: These are the winners & losers of the AI scare trade
title_zh: 这些是人工智能恐慌交易的赢家和输家
summary: Investors have been favoring artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure while pulling back from software (IGV), as US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) navigate renewed volatility.
summary_zh: 随着美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）再次出现波动，投资者一直青睐人工智能 (AI) 基础设施，同时撤出软件 (IGV)。
